Callout.Name: Fight at the Bus Terminal
Callout.Message: Fight between two groups at a bus terminal.
Callout.Advisory: Six or more involved, services delayed.

Script.Line: It started on the bus and it carried on off it.
Six of us and not one of us threw the first punch.
The buses can wait. This is not about the buses.

Lines.Approach: Six of them at the terminal and the buses cannot get in or out.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
